standard-dialogue-before-spirits-of-the-.npc: It's not that good, it's a bit warm.

standard-dialogue-after-spirits-of-the-e.npc: The curse has been removed. Word around the town is that you were the one who helped remove it.

standard-dialogue-after-spirits-of-the-e.player: Yes that is correct. The spirits of the Elid cursed the town for throwing away a statue to Elidinis. I got it back

standard-dialogue-after-spirits-of-the-e.npc: Well we thank you. You're pretty much a local hero now.
